column3: “Hardly touching” renders not entering the path with his feet.
“My friend” renders the one who loves Me.
“Brought” renders taking hold of the person.
The separate references to men of contention and men of war are compressed.
“Olive trees” identifies oil trees; the other tree names are rendered as cypresses, elms, and boxwood.
“Consider” renders setting or placing, with its object understood.
The question “What are they?” about former things is not explicit.
“As if they were mortar” specifies the comparison with clay.
“I was the first to tell” supplies a verb in the opening phrase.
“As empty as the wind” combines wind and emptiness into a comparison.
